text: Integrated a dedicated 12-parameter affine streaming kernel, affine loss-only trial kernel, and explicit-workspace adapter to the shared bounded projected-patch optimizer. Rigid and affine result/cache/counter types remain separate while objective semantics and PatchLinearization algebra are shared. The physical metric covers translation, rotation, diagonal strain, and xy/xz/yz shear at frozen fixed-world probes; actual maximum displacement uses the exact before-inverse/after affine at those probes. Fixed a shared correctness issue found by the unsupported-data fixture: data rank is now checked before gradient convergence, so zero-information fits cannot report success. Evidence: explicit 27x12 oracle objective <=2e-12, gradient <=3e-11, curvature <=5e-11; loss-only/full <=2e-13 with zero gradient evaluations. Independent optimization/selection phantom recovered translation/rotation/scale/shear to <=0.008 affine-element error and <=0.025 mm across four landmarks. Impossible 1e-12 mm cap records 3 MaximumDisplacement rejections, one data linearization, zero trial evaluations. Unsupported samples report RankDeficient(0,12), zero solver/trial calls. Complete JVM and Scala.js suites 57/57 each, including unchanged rigid tests; final affine refinement rerun 3/3 each. Ownership 1191 public names/64 canonical owners; PRD 148 IDs/27 nodes/94 edges/DAG; build graph 27/94; whitespace checks clean. No runtime or MRI-accuracy claim.
